blurb: Chautauqua Golf Club offers two four-star-rated championship golf courses designed by Seymour Dunn and Donald Ross. The club has a rich history with many World Golf Hall of Famers and notable figures having played there. It provides a golf experience that challenges both experienced players and novices, emphasizing quality, service, and environmental stewardship.
